rplt-01-c3.text: Ren, M. et al (2019). The origins of cannabis smoking: Chemical residue evidence from the first millennium BCE in the Pamirs. Science Advances 5(6): eaaw1391.
rplt-01-c3.quote: cannabis plants were burned in wooden braziers during mortuary ceremonies
rplt-01-c3.claim: Wooden braziers from the Jirzankal cemetery in the Pamir Mountains of western China, about 2,500 years old, held burned stones with cannabis compounds pointing to plants unusually rich in THC
